details: The frozen live API manifest stores integer observation_id but not observation_uuid, while the Open Data association key is observation_uuid.
v3 therefore attempted to identify the live observation through mutable proxy fields such as taxon_id, coordinates, observed_on and positional_accuracy.

The official Open Data documentation states that monthly metadata tables can omit photos that are nevertheless present in the Open Dataset bucket, so requiring every selected bucket photo to have a photos.csv row is not a valid completeness assumption.
The official taxa documentation specifies backslash-delimited ancestry; the v2 resolver used slash splitting when checking genus/root ancestry.

consequence: Preserve this STOP result. Do not interpret it as absence of source provenance or as a biological result. A new pre-pixel amendment may correct identifier/schema roles without replacing any of the frozen 60,000 selected rows.
